title: App is good
body: I started using this program, often on Mac, and I really liked it! But can you please turn off the rollover function from the main menu to the asterisk menu (i.e. statistics) by double-clicking anywhere? It's very annoying when you even click twice on a certain habit or anywhere accidentally, and it throws the bucket over! And so the program is very cool!
author: Andriy pron

title: Amazing app!
body:
"I've been using this app for about half a year now, and I'm very satisfied with the functionality and design. 🤩

The only small thing that bothered me was that if I set a URL Action button for a timed task, I couldn't start the timer without triggering the URL shortcut. 🥲

However, a recent update added the teature to start the timer separately. Huge thanks to the devs for the consistent updates and fixes. This is my go-to everyday app! ❤️

title: Simple habit tracker
body:
Nice app. But there are few problems:  
1. I’m not able to move task to another day (e.g. move to Tomorrow)
2. There should be a better way to revert task completion other than shaking (especially on the widgets screen)
3. Sync is slow in widgets (huge delays in the task widget). But probably the problem isn’t in application itself

title: Just wow.
body:
You dont need to have any other habbit tracker. Especialy if you are power user you can enjoy flawless Shortcuts and Health integration.

I have hooked Streaks automation to my task & pomodorro apps and enjoy frictionless noting of my daily task progreses. 

Just wow. 

For the develper: please do not delete app if you decide to move on. I rely heavily on it. 
Im good with paying some fees for upgrading application for new features (see hook app model) but if you will switch to subscription model - I will admit that this switch will be === to the delition of the app from appstore. 

Other wise you have done great job and the current payment for the app totaly worth it and a little bit more.

author: mr.Mozg

title: Is it worth it?
body: So I’ve been using this app for a week and everything was just perfect except… I also use this app to reach my work out goals and it’s not sharing results with the health app. Everything else though is just great. The Design is outstanding, I like the fact you can customize all the colors of your goals you choose EVEN THE APP ICON isn’t that just AWESOME who else does that, right? In conclusion I think it’s totally worth it’s price and all the tiny bugs will be solved soon. Keep it up!
